# Zoom Navigation

<!-- Generated by generate-swiftui-skill.py; edit the library sources. -->

Category: Motion

On iOS 18+, pair matchedTransitionSource on the tapped view with navigationTransition(.zoom) on its destination, sharing an ID and namespace. Unlike matched geometry, this connects navigation presentations. Inspired by Enid (@ios_dev_alb).

- Before: Default navigation transition
- After: Zoom from the tapped view

APIs: `matchedTransitionSource`, `navigationTransition`, `zoom`

## Complete improved example

Adapt the behavior to the app; demonstration controls and values are illustrative.

```swift
import SwiftUI

struct ZoomNavigationDoExample: View {
    @Namespace private var namespace
    @State private var presented = false

    var body: some View {
        #if os(iOS)
        if #available(iOS 18, *) {
            // excerpt:start
            NavigationStack {
                NavigationLink {
                    Image(systemName: "photo.fill")
                        .font(.system(size: 100))
                        .navigationTitle("Photo")
                        .navigationTransition(.zoom(sourceID: "detail", in: namespace))
                } label: {
                    Label("Open photo", systemImage: "photo.fill")
                        .padding()
                        .matchedTransitionSource(id: "detail", in: namespace)
                }
            }
            // excerpt:end
        } else {
            Text("Requires iOS 18 or later")
        }
        #else
        Text("Try this presentation on iPhone or iPad")
            .font(.caption)
        #endif
    }
}
```
